data.name: Ainesh
data.gender_notes: Ainesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ainesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Indra, the deity of rain. This name evokes the power and vitality of the monsoon season and the nourishing effects of rain. The name Ainesh carries the meaning “God of Rain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ainesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ainesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ainesh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
